description: This file defines API routes for managing a shopping cart in a food delivery backend. It includes endpoints to retrieve, add/update, remove individual items, and clear the cart for the current user, utilizing FastAPI, SQLAlchemy ORM, and dependency injection.

methods.name: CartOut _cart_out(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Helper function to generate the CartOut schema object representing the current user's cart, including items and subtotal.

methods.name: CartOut get_cart(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the current user's cart.

methods.name: CartOut upsert_cart_item( payload: CartItemIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to add a new item to the cart or update the quantity of an existing item.

methods.name: CartOut remove_cart_item( cart_item_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to remove a specific item from the cart.

methods.name: CartOut clear_cart(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to remove all items from the current user's cart.
